column12: Re-open Solicitation. Vendor responses to the solicitation are due 02/29/2024 16:00 PST. Please access the 'Open Solicitations' tab in the VIPR Vendor application (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/vipr/vendor/) to start your response. The Department of Agriculture (USDA), US Forest Service (USFS), ESB West Zone (Regions 5, and 6) requirement for Heavy Equipment for use during Local, Regional, and nationwide fire suppression and all-hazard incidents was originally solicited under solicitation number 12569R23Q7000. This amendment is to re-open this solicitation to conduct an open season Onboarding in accordance with Exhibit H - Special Contract Requirements of the original solicitation. IMPORTANT NOTE: Onboarding is not a new procurement and operates differently than a new solicitation. Onboarding is a result of the provisions established in the original solicitation and is issued as a solicitation amendment to the original solicitation. The terms and conditions of the original solicitation require that 'The award decision under the open season solicitation is based upon the same evaluation factors/sub-factors as the original solicitation.' Additionally, the terms and conditions of the original solicitation require that, 'The terms and conditions of any resulting new IBPA awards are identical to the original awards and solicitation, to include period of performance.' Accordingly, while the Government will entertain suggestions and Industry input regarding the Onboarding amendment, the Government anticipates very little change to result from this input, especially as it regards any potential changes to the evaluation factors or resulting terms and conditions. column11: Townsends Inlet to Cape May Inlet, Cape May County, New Jersey
column12: *********MAKE NOTE: AMENDMENT #001 HAS BEEN ADDED TO THIS SOLICITATION ********* *********DO NOT STAPLE BID PROPOSAL DOCUMENTS********** The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Philadelphia District, intends to award a firm fixed contract that consists of Maintenance dredging under this contract. Contract work consists of maintenance dredging in the Townsends Inlet to Cape May Inlet, NJ : a. Placing approximately 231,000 cubic yards of beachfill, along the Atlantic Ocean coastline in the Borough of Avalon, Cape May County, New Jersey. b. Placing approximately 464,000 cubic yards of beachfill, along the Atlantic Ocean coastline in the Borough of Stone Harbor, Cape May County, New Jersey. c. Re-grading of existing dunes within the project limits to minimize areas with significantly steep landward slopes. Re-graded areas will be planted with dune grass or other appropriate vegetation. d. Placing additional quantities of sand in the Boroughs of Avalon and Stone Harbor based on project needs and availability of funding. Contract will include 4 options for each community for sand quantities of 175,000 cy, 100,000 cy, 50,000 cy and 25,000 cy. The period of performance for the base contract will be 167 calendar days for base work and all options. Estimated cost range of the project is $25,000,000 to $100,000,000. Neither telephonic, mailed nor faxed requests for hard copies of this solicitation will be accepted. DO NOT STAPLE SOLICITATION. Solicitation must be printed on one side. The solicitation will only be available online; in order to download the solicitation offerors must access the official U.S. government website for people who make, receive, and manage federal awards.
